bundle.shortDescription: Local sniper terminal and strategy backtester for pons v2.
bundle.longDescription: quarrel is a local desktop application. It watches pons v2 token launches, evaluates them against a transparent boolean filter, and lets the same filter be backtested against locally indexed on-chain history. Nothing leaves the machine except JSON-RPC to the endpoint the user configured.
